name: Shenzhen InfoGem Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen InfoGem Technologies Co., Ltd. provides financial technology services primarily in China, the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Australia, Spain, Russia, and internationally. The company operates in financial information technology services, mobile information services, and e-commerce. It offers imaging technology, bank operation, risk audit, bank channel, and content management services, as well as artificial intelligence technology service; and financial special equipment products including intelligent seal control machine, intelligent printing, and counterfeit detection batch stamping machine.
